audit.whatIsWrong: The chart contradicted its own why-text on five of seven rows — most starkly at Level 6, where win[4] said 'Heimerdinger' while whys[4] says 'you own this all-in'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Kennen, Skill, Skill) matches every whys[] entry as written: the turret triangle owns 1-3, 4-5 is even, level 6 is Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom window, and first item onward evens out because he rebuilds the zone between trades.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped as matched full/content pairs to Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Kennen, Skill, Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic 'reassess every all-in at 6' line and gave the level away to Heimerdinger by implication.
audit.why: Level 6 is Kennen's spike here: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s over 550 units and Heimerdinger has no mobility at all — his ultimate only upgrades a spell. His grenade is a flat 11s and his rockets 11/10/9/8/7s at 1325 range.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around the E-in stun-lock, and the cooldown block now carries the 11s grenade, the 1325-range rockets and the flat 120s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] said the grenade cancels 'your E-in or R channel'.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is not a channel — Riot's text is 'summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions' and the kit carries only a zone flag, so a stun strands Kennen inside his own storm rather than ending it. The grenade only stuns on a direct hit; the surrounding area is a slow.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] now says the direct-hit stun breaks the step-up and resets the zone.

edits.before: Land his E stun grenade to cancel your E-in or R channel and reset the zone
edits.after: Land the CH-2 grenade's direct hit to break your step-up and reset the zone

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom + Zhonya wins any grouped fight top-side. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Heimerdinger's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is your window: step in, stun-lock him through the turret cover, and UPGRADE!!! gives an immobile Heimerdinger no exit.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — a flat 11s, and only a direct hit stuns. Step up once it is spent. - Micro-Rockets (11s at rank 1) chip from 1325. - Your R: flat 120s, kill windows only.
